opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the platform — including Agentforce, Salesforce's AI agents, and Data Cloud — up 11% YoY.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: The largest running cost — Salesforce's big sales force and marketing machine, up 1% YoY.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company day to day — up 21% YoY.

opex.name: Restructuring
opex.note: One-off costs of reorganizing teams and facilities — a $298M charge this quarter.

otherDetail: A $96M gain on strategic investments — stakes Salesforce holds in other companies — plus $72M of other income, mostly interest earned.

segments.name: Subscription and support
segments.note: The core software subscriptions — Sales, Service, Slack, Tableau, Agentforce and Data Cloud.

segments.name: Professional services and other
segments.note: Consulting and training that help customers roll the software out.

takeaways.text: Data Cloud and AI recurring revenue reached $900M a year, up 120%, and Salesforce had closed 5,000 Agentforce deals since October — more than 3,000 of them paid. The AI-agent business was small next to $10B of quarterly revenue, but it was the fastest-growing thing in the company.
takeaways.title: AI revenue became real

takeaways.text: Remaining performance obligation — work customers have signed for but Salesforce hasn't yet delivered or billed — reached $63.4B, up 11%. The current portion, due within a year, rose 9% to $30.2B, locking in most of next year's growth in advance.
takeaways.title: A $63B backlog

takeaways.text: A $298M restructuring charge — severance and facility costs — sat in running costs this quarter. Even with it, net income rose 18% to $1.71B, and for the full year Salesforce generated a record $13.1B of operating cash flow.
takeaways.title: Restructuring weighed, cash flow didn't

verdict: Salesforce closed its fiscal year with revenue up 8% to $10.0B and net income up 18% to $1.71B — and the new story was AI: Data Cloud and AI recurring revenue hit $900M, up 120%, with 5,000 Agentforce deals signed since October.
